question: What is the final result of dissolving everything into one's own consciousness?
premises: All that has been dissolved is finally absorbed into one's own consciousness.
That consciousness is full and self-sufficient.
When contemplated, it destroys the ocean of samsara.
inference: Contemplation of plenary consciousness culminates in the dissolution of samsara.
plain_english: All of that should be dissolved into one's own consciousness; when contemplated, that consciousness, full in its own nature, becomes the fire that dissolves the ocean of worldly existence.
